title: Code that reads page.archived or passes after to append breaks after opting into Notion-Version 2026-03-11
symptoms: page.archived is undefined on every page
Append block children calls that pass after stop working
Blocks of type transcription no longer appear; they come back as meeting_notes
cause: Version 2026-03-11 renamed archived to in_trash in requests and responses, replaced the after parameter with a position object, and renamed the transcription block type to meeting_notes.
fix: Update field names and block type checks before switching versions. In the JS SDK, upgrade to 5.12.0 or later and set notionVersion explicitly.
affected: Notion-Version 2026-03-11; @notionhq/client 5.12.0 and later when notionVersion is set to it
